build_cuda_wrapper_library: build a pure Python ctypes wrapper for the CUDA runtime library to avoid compiling a separate shared library
create_cudaMalloc_wrapper: create a wrapper function that allocates device memory via cudaMalloc using ctypes bindings
create_cudaMemcpy_wrapper: create a wrapper function that copies data between device and host memory via cudaMemcpy
create_cudaIpcMemHandle_wrapper: create a wrapper class for cudaIpcMemHandle_t to enable inter-process CUDA memory sharing
test_CudaRTLibrary: test the CudaRTLibrary class to verify it loads libcudart and exposes cudaSetDevice, cudaMalloc, cudaFree, cudaMemcpy methods
